usedFor: Userflow knows who is onboarding, and Microsoft Excel keeps the list when “User Created” runs “Add Row To Table”.

bestTemplate.name: “User Created” in Userflow, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each new Userflow user adds a row to an Excel table, giving you a running sign-up list.

watchOut: “Update Row” pairs only with “Group Updated” here, so “User Created” can add rows but not edit them.
